subject: Latency insights and tier migration proposal
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@skyledger.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: SkyLedger SRE <sre@skyledger.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sudden tail-latency increase after model rollout — renewal impact

Hi Marissa / Priyom,

Quick note from our SRE team: since Redwood pushed the model refresh on 2027-04-11 we've observed a ~3x increase in 99th percentile token latency for our bursty inference paths (seq len ~512). This is affecting interactive workflows in Prod-1 and shows up as an increased error rate in our client-side timeouts.

We have a renewal discussion with Procurement scheduled for early May and this trend is making the leadership team push back on renewing at current terms. Specifically they're asking whether Redwood can: (1) commit to a higher uptime/tail-latency SLO for Prod-1, (2) propose a remediation and timeline, and (3) include a commercial remediation (credits or a pilot upgrade) for the performance delta we've seen in April.

Can we set up a short call tomorrow? We need a clear mitigation plan to present to our procurement team.

Thanks,
Tom
Head of Integrations, SkyLedger

On Mon, 2027-04-18 at 09:12, attached logs: (skyledger-latency-snapshot-0418.csv)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@skyledger.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@skyledger.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden tail-latency increase after model rollout — renewal impact

Tom — thanks for flagging and for the sample CSV. I'm sorry you're seeing the regression. We take this seriously and we'll move quickly. Immediate next steps from our side:

- I'll schedule a 30-min sync today to align on impact and next steps.
- As a short-term mitigation we can route Prod-1 traffic to our v2-slim model variant (same functional outputs but ~25% faster 99p latency) while SRE works through the root cause. This is a non-invasive option we can flip with no code changes on your side.
- We'll draft a Reliability Addendum that lays out a pilot to migrate Prod-1 to a dedicated capacity pool (6-week pilot), an uplifted SLO target for the pilot, and a credit proposal for April.

I'm attaching an initial outline; Vivek and Neha — can you review and confirm feasibility? Priyom — looping you in to coordinate the renewal timeline.

Proposed times for a quick call: Today 1:00–1:30pm PT or 4:00–4:30pm PT.

— Marissa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: (reliability_outline_v0.1.md)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden tail-latency increase after model rollout — internal SRE notes

Marissa / team — quick technical readout from SRE after looking at the SkyLedger traces and KV cache metrics:

- Root cause hypothesis: a new attention kernel path in the rollout increases memory pressure for large batches leading to more frequent CPU-GPU syncs under burst traffic.
- Immediate mitigation: enable ephemeral weighted routing to v2-slim for Prod-1 and raise per-request concurrency cap for the session-based route. Expected improvement: 20–30% reduction in 99p latency for the problematic path.
- Medium-term: provision a 4-GPU dedicated pool for Prod-1 with pinned quantized kernels and pre-warmed KV caches; this should steady out tail latency to ~99.95% SLO under current load patterns.

Operational ask for Commercial: we recommend offering a 6-week Dedicated pilot (no long-term commit) with a SLA of 99.95% for HTTP success and 99.9% for 99th-percentile tail latency for the pilot window. For the client-impacting week in April we can recommend a one-time credit covering 18–25% of that month's hosted fees (we estimate midpoint ~20%).

I've attached the proposed routing policy as YAML and the rough capacity numbers. If Commercial wants to soften the credit ask for negotiation, 15% is still reasonable and easier to approve.

— Neha
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: (proposed_routing_policy.yaml)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden tail-latency increase after model rollout — commercial framing

Team — thanks Neha. Commercial take: SkyLedger is mid-market with ARR just below our dedicated threshold. To protect the renewal pipeline I suggest the following compromise to present:

- Offer the 6-week Dedicated pilot as Neha suggested, priced at a pilot-discount rate (60% of list) to make the economics clear.
- Offer a 15% credit against April usage (one-time) rather than 20% up front. If SkyLedger opts into a Dedicated annual commit within 90 days we can bump the credit to 20% and include a waived onboarding fee.
- Include a clear rollback clause that moves traffic back to hosted v2-default if we see any regression during the pilot.

I'll prepare the commercial language and a DocuSign envelope. Priyom, can you own the external send with the addendum?

— Vivek
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@skyledger.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@skyledger.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Reliability addendum and pilot proposal — SkyLedger renewal path

Tom / Elena — following our diagnostics call, please find the formal proposal attached: Reliability_Addendum_v1.pdf. High-level summary:

1) Short-term mitigation: we will enable weighted routing to the v2-slim variant for Prod-1 immediately (no code changes required).
2) Pilot: 6-week Dedicated capacity pilot (4x A100-equivalent GPUs) with an elevated SLO: 99.95% uptime and 99.9% 99p latency objective. Pilot pricing at 60% of published Dedicated list.
3) Credit: 15% one-time credit for April usage. If SkyLedger signs an annual Dedicated commit within 90 days we will increase credit to 20% and waive onboarding fees.
4) Rollout & rollback: we will provide a canary plan and an automated rollback policy; Neha's team will present a runbook for the pilot cutover.

Next steps:
- Please review the attached addendum and sign the DocuSign link below if acceptable.
- Proposed meeting to finalize terms: Thu 2027-04-22 10:00–10:30am PT or Fri 2027-04-23 8:00–8:30am PT.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/RDW-8742
Attachment: Reliability_Addendum_v1.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to resolving this quickly.

— Marissa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-04-21T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reliability addendum and pilot proposal — SkyLedger renewal path

Marissa — thanks for the quick follow-up and the proposal. We appreciate the pilot offer and the routing mitigation. A few clarifying asks before we sign:

- Can you include explicit SLO language for the 99p latency objective in the addendum (measurable metric + measurement window)?
- Confirm that the Dedicated pilot can be scheduled to start the week of 2027-05-03 and that the weighted routing change is reversible by our SREs if we see functional regressions.
- We accept the 15% April credit as a start; we'd like the 20% conditional language to be explicit (i.e., what counts as a 'commit' and timing).

We can meet Thu 2027-04-22 10:00am PT. Looking forward to the runbook and the SLO wording.

Best,
Elena
VP Product, SkyLedger
